verdicts.reason: A centres the logo while the quote and quote mark are left-aligned, so the column has no single axis. Its can floats unanchored above the olive circle, which leaves the original's can-on-circle layering broken and a big dead zone at the bottom. B keeps the logo, quote mark and quote on one left edge and layers the can over the circle as the original does. In both, the quote is set too small for a story canvas, the attribution sits jammed against the quote, and the centred can fights the left-aligned text column.
